channel.title: AI Threat Watch: IL
channel.description: Verified case files located in IL.

item.title: [CRITICAL] DuneSlide: two 9.8 Cursor flaws let prompt injection escape sandbox for OS-level RCE
item.description: Cato Networks found a non-default working_directory was added to Cursor's allow list and unresolved symlinks fell back to their own path, letting injected prompts overwrite the sandbox binary and run any command. Target: Cursor AI code editor (2.x). IL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Lahav 433 arrests 20-year-old who animated stolen ID photos with AI to open bank accounts
item.description: Israel Police allege a 20-year-old bought ID photos on the darknet, used AI to animate them past remote video account-opening checks, and used AI agents to open bank accounts and cards in hundreds of victims' names. Target: Israeli banks and about 120 identity theft victims. IL. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Check Point finds DNS tunnel out of ChatGPT's code sandbox leaking chats and files
item.description: Check Point Research found ChatGPT's supposedly offline Python container could reach the internet via DNS, so one malicious prompt or custom GPT could exfiltrate messages and files or open a remote shell. OpenAI fixed it Target: OpenAI ChatGPT code execution runtime. IL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] HashJack: prompts hidden in URL fragments hijack Comet, Edge Copilot and Gemini in Chrome
item.description: Cato CTRL showed instructions in a URL fragment, which never reaches the server, are read by AI browser assistants and can push phishing links or make agentic browsers leak data. Perplexity and Microsoft patched it. Target: Perplexity Comet, Copilot in Edge, Gemini in Chrome. IL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Invitation Is All You Need: poisoned calendar invites make Gemini control smart homes
item.description: Researchers from Tel Aviv University, Technion and SafeBreach showed 14 indirect prompt injections where hidden text in Google Calendar invites made Gemini open shutters, start Zoom calls and delete events. Target: Google Gemini assistant and Google Home integrations. IL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Wiz finds auth bypass exposing private enterprise apps on Wix's Base44 platform
item.description: Wiz Research found undocumented register and verify-otp endpoints that needed only a public app_id to create verified accounts on private Base44 apps, bypassing SSO. Wix fixed it within 24 hours of the 9 July report. Target: Base44 (Wix) AI app platform. IL. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Deepfakes of Netanyahu, Gadot and Musk drive Ostin Technology pump-and-dump in Israel
item.description: From April 2025 a campaign used deepfakes of Netanyahu, Amir Yaron, Gal Gadot and Elon Musk plus fake WhatsApp groups impersonating the TASE and Israeli banks to pump Nasdaq-listed Ostin Technology; it fell 93 percent. Target: Israeli retail investors. IL. Verification: reported.
